units: Targ. Gen. II, 19 לְוַת (constr.); a. v. fr.—With suff. לְוָתִי, לְוָתָךְ &c. unto me, unto thee &c.
Ib. XXXIX, 15, sq. (h. text אֵצֶל); a. v. fr.—מִלְּוַת from the presence of.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 9:33">Targ. Ex. IX, 33</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 111b:8">B. Kam. 111ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 62b:12">B. Mets. 62ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כי שכיבנא … נפק לוותי</he> when I die, R. O. shall come to meet me; a. fr.
